    • move

      public void move(int r, int c)
      Parameters:
      r - - row to move the piece to
      c - - column to move the piece to moves the piece to this new row and column and performs the following operations: - "take" piece if there is a piece there (remove from the board) - check to see if the other king is placed in check - check to see if the game has ended from this move - create a notation based on the conditions above - switch the turn so that it is the other player's turn this move will be used for all pieces that don't have any other special conditions (castling, enpassant)

    • makeNotation

      public void makeNotation(boolean checked, boolean captured, boolean ended, int oldR, int oldC, int newR, int newC, String sound)
      Parameters:
      checked - - whether or not the remove resulted in a check
      captured - - whether or not a piece was captured in the move
      ended - - whether or not the game was ended by this move
      oldR - - the old row of the piece
      oldC - - the old column of the piece
      newR - - the new row of the piece
      newC - - the new column of the piece
      sound - - the sound of the move to be saved method to be overriden by the child classes to create a notation based on the conditions above
